8: # Infographic Visualizer
9: 
10: > **⚠️ CHECK TEMPLATES:** Wrong template names WILL cause render failures.
11: 
12: ## When to Use & Available Templates
13: 
14: **✅ Use infographic when:**
15: - **Feature list / checklist**: `list-grid-badge-card`, `list-grid-candy-card-lite`, `list-grid-ribbon-card`, `list-column-done-list`, `list-column-vertical-icon-arrow`, `list-column-simple-vertical-arrow`, `list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow`, `list-row-simple-illus`, `list-sector-plain-text`, `list-zigzag-down-compact-card`, `list-zigzag-down-simple`, `list-zigzag-up-compact-card`, `list-zigzag-up-simple`
16: - **Timeline / milestones**: `sequence-timeline-simple`, `sequence-timeline-rounded-rect-node`, `sequence-timeline-simple-illus`
17: - **Step-by-step process**: `sequence-snake-steps-simple`, `sequence-snake-steps-compact-card`, `sequence-snake-steps-underline-text`, `sequence-stairs-front-compact-card`, `sequence-stairs-front-pill-badge`, `sequence-ascending-steps`, `sequence-ascending-stairs-3d-underline-text`, `sequence-circular-simple`, `sequence-pyramid-simple`, `sequence-mountain-underline-text`, `sequence-cylinders-3d-simple`, `sequence-zigzag-steps-underline-text`, `sequence-zigzag-pucks-3d-simple`, `sequence-horizontal-zigzag-underline-text`, `sequence-horizontal-zigzag-simple-illus`, `sequence-color-snake-steps-horizontal-icon-line`

29: ## Syntax Structure
30: 
31: ```plain
32: infographic <template-name>
33: data
34:   title Title
35:   desc Description
36:   items
37:     - label Label
38:       value 12.5
39:       desc Explanation
40:       icon mdi/rocket-launch
41: theme
42:   palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316
43: ```
44: 
45: **Rules:** First line `infographic <template-name>` (must match template list) | 2-space indentation | `key value` pairs (space-separated, **NOT** `key: value`) | `-` prefix for arrays | Compare templates need exactly 2 root items with `children` | SWOT needs exactly 4 items (Strengths/Weaknesses/Opportunities/Threats in English) | Quadrant needs exactly 4 items with `children` | list templates use `desc` not `value` | `hierarchy-structure` max 3 levels | Use `desc` not `description` | Use `items` not `steps`
46: 
47: ### ⚠️ Common Mistakes (will cause render failure)
48: 
49: ```plain
50: ❌ WRONG — Do NOT use YAML colon syntax:
51: template: list-grid-badge-card     ← wrong! no "template:" key
52: title: My Title                    ← wrong! colons are not allowed
53: items:                             ← wrong! no colon after items
54:   - label: Item One                ← wrong! no colon after label
55:     description: Some text         ← wrong! field is "desc" not "description"
56:     value: "100"                   ← wrong! no colon, and value must be numeric
57: steps:                             ← wrong! field is "items" not "steps"
58: left:                              ← wrong! compare uses 2 root items + children
59:   label: Option A                  ← wrong! compare structure is flat items
60: quadrants:                         ← wrong! quadrant uses 4 items + children
61: 
62: ✅ CORRECT — Space-separated key-value, 2-space indent:
63: infographic list-grid-badge-card
64: data
65:   title My Title
66:   items
67:     - label Item One
68:       desc Some text
69:       value 100
70: ```
71: 
72: ## Data Fields
73: 
74: | Field | Description | Example |
75: |-------|-------------|---------|
76: | `label` | Item title/name (required) | `label Q1 Sales` |
77: | `desc` | Description text | `desc $1.28B \| +20%` |
78: | `value` | Numeric value (charts/funnels only) | `value 128` |
79: | `time` | Time label (timeline templates only) | `time Q1 2024` |
80: | `icon` | Icon: `mdi/icon-name` ([Iconify](https://icon-sets.iconify.design/)) | `icon mdi/star` |
81: | `illus` | Illustration name ([unDraw](https://undraw.co/illustrations)) | `illus coding` |
82: | `children` | Nested items (hierarchy/compare) | See examples |
83: | `done` | Completion status (checklist) | `done true` |
84: 
85: ## Core Examples
86:

15: ## Syntax Structure
16: 
17: ### Basic Format
18: 
19: ```plain
20: infographic <template-name>
21: data
22:   title Title Text
23:   desc Description Text
24:   items
25:     - label Item Label
26:       value 12.5
27:       desc Item description
28:       icon mdi/rocket-launch
29: theme
30:   palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316
31: ```
32: 
33: ### Syntax Rules
34: 
35: | Rule | Description | Example |
36: |------|-------------|---------|
37: | Entry line | Must start with `infographic <template-name>` | `infographic list-grid-badge-card` |
38: | Indentation | Two spaces per level | `  items` / `    - label` |
39: | Key-value | Format: `key value` (space separated) | `label Product Name` |
40: | Arrays | Use `-` prefix for items | `- label Item1` |
41: | Blocks | `data` and `theme` are top-level blocks | See example above |
42: 
43: ### Nesting Hierarchy
44: 
45: ```plain
46: infographic template-name     # Entry (required)
47: data                          # Data block (required)
48:   title xxx                   # Level 1 (2 spaces)
49:   desc xxx                    # Level 1
50:   items                       # Level 1
51:     - label xxx               # Level 2 (4 spaces)
52:       value 100               # Level 3 (6 spaces)
53:       desc xxx                # Level 3
54:       children                # Level 3 (for hierarchy)
55:         - label xxx           # Level 4 (8 spaces)
56: theme                         # Theme block (optional)
57:   palette #fff #000           # Level 1
58: ```
